data.name: Lucky
data.description:
Lucky, the brainchild of Chelsea Knight, burst onto the scene in a flurry of fuzzy guitars and captivating storytelling. Growing up in the rural town of Staghorn Flat, Australia, Knight began writing music whist working at her family’s sign shop. Blending the raw energy of alternative rock, with the dreamy haze of modern indie, her music captures the nuances of life's everyday moments and dives deep, putting you right at the centre of her world.

Knight’s 12 month debut was very compelling, seeing high rotation adds on Australia’s tastemaker station triple j, opening for USA 90’s icons Garbage across the nation, receiving multiple additions to Spotify’s coveted Fresh Finds Global playlist, among a laundry list of others, winning the triple j slot at Beyond The Valley Festival, hitting viral status three separate times on Shazam, showcases in Austin, Texas at SXSW, and an inclusion on NME’s Global 100 emerging acts to keep a close eye on — crushing her Australia debut and building impressive global momentum. The rest of 2026 will see her drop her debut EP April 10, and head out on her first Australian headline tour.

Presented by Not Dead Yet.

This is an 19+ event

data.name: Tommy Barlow
data.description:
Tommy Barlow grew up in a very musical household in Cambridge on a steady diet of traditional folk artists such as Flook and Michael McGoldrick. He subsequently moved to London to attend Guildhall where he studied Electronic Music . His music uses field recordings, guitars, strings, samples, his unique voice and sometimes bagpipes. His influences range from Bon Iver and Steve Reich to Mount Kimbie and James Blake.

His self-released mixtape from 2024 Mustard Seeds offered a window into his process and lead to Tommy being a regular at London venues such as The George Tavern, Shacklewell Arms and Spanners. He has played festivals such as C2C, Pitchfork Paris and most recently with bands like Chanel Beads.

Presented by Not Dead Yet.

This is an 19+ event

data.name: SOOK-YIN LEE ANTI-BAND & friends!
data.description:
**SOOK-YIN LEE ANTI-BAND & friends:**

**MyGirl BoyGirl** (members of New Chance)

**STEPHEN JACKMAN-TORKOFF**

**Sadstab & JIEUN KIM**

***Fri. Nov. 27 Doors: 8PM Show: 9PM***

Hot off the heels of a TransCanada tour, Canadian multimedia icon, **Sook-Yin Lee**, returns to TORONTO/ Tkaronto with her **Anti-Band** featuring **Dylan Gamble** (Hot Garbage) on guitar, dancer **Ronnie Clarke**, and performance artist/ vocalist **Sarah Kilpack**. Lee brings together some of her fave artists for an adventurous gathering: **Stephen Jackman-Torkoff**, wandering poet, painter, and lover of life, is known for their striking DIY performance odysseys. **MyGirl BoyGirl** (members of New Chance) features **Victoria Cheong**, experimental pop and electronic music composer and producer, and **Johnny Spence**, composer, musician, and sound designer. Meanwhile, the life of the party is **DJ Sadstab**, tattoo artist, and brilliant force of nature who helps run Play de Record, the legendary independent record store. Experience LIVE ART courtesy of muralist **Jieun Kim**, an art instigator who will get you making art too!

“Sook-Yin Lee's set was nothing short of a joyful transcendent experience.” Exclaim! Magazine

This is an 19+ event

Presented by Hidden Lane
